title: LeftBlock: shift-left sensitive-data protection
description: LeftBlock is the final product name and the repository transfer to https://github.com/DataParade-io/LeftBlock is complete. Source is checkpointed locally at e3934c90bedec7fbaa137f62c6e0503ba708ed9b with hook scanning and receipt verification. The README shift-left Mermaid diagram is verified. Actual local installation and synthetic validation are complete for all 137 eligible repositories with empty hook locations: clean commits passed, sensitive fixtures were blocked, and project state was preserved. Three repositories using hook managers still need 17 checkout-specific adapters, owner coordination and required project workflows; this is pending integration work, not a scanner failure. Generated/vendor/upstream exclusions and unresolved Git pointers remain outside completed coverage. The new LeftBlock PyPI release is not published: exact trusted-publisher approval and authenticated management access are pending. Existing pudicus releases are preserved. Ryan owns the logo; later factual publicity remains review-only.
